movedScenarioPolicy.rule: Case routing, mutation and assertion plus DebugConsole, AnimalViewer and EquipmentSlots screenshot, evidence-directory, evidence-summary and Smoke.* scenario-verdict policy belongs only to the optional QA assembly. Player assemblies expose neutral state and operations; neutral non-scenario feature telemetry remains product-owned.

retainedNeutralHost.rule: The player assembly may validate and attach an optional owner-bound QA participant, expose opaque run/evidence roots and relay lifecycle receipts. It may not compose evidence paths, select cases, mutate product state for a fixture, capture evidence or publish DebugConsole, AnimalViewer or EquipmentSlots Smoke.* scenario verdicts.
